mentions.name: Home Assistant room touch panel
mentions.description: This product is a smart home control system integrated with Home Assistant that puts a touch panel in every room to run predefined actions. It aims to make smart home control widely available and more affordable than relying on mobile or web apps. An alpha version is working and a panel redesign is in progress, built with Rust and Slint, with plans to eventually produce the company's own affordable devices.
mentions.problem: Mobile app and web app control solutions fit less well, and smart home control is not widely available or affordable for everyone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an integrated system with Home Assistant for making it widely available and more affordable for everyone. The solution consists in doing a touch panel for every room that can run predefined actions.
mentions.author: mateioprea
